name: What is the process for replacing windows?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for replacing windows?

acceptedAnswer.text: The window replacement process typically begins with an initial consultation and measurement, followed by material selection and ordering. Once the new windows arrive, our team prepares the work area, removes the old windows, and installs the new ones according to manufacturer specifications. This includes proper sealing and insulation. Finally, we clean up the site and conduct a final walk-through with you to ensure satisfaction.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves consultation, measurement, ordering, removal of old windows, installation of new ones, sealing, and cleanup.
